# Herdling

> Herdling is a free phone app (iPhone and Android) for herdr, the terminal workspace for coding agents. It shows the agents on your own Mac or Linux computers, notifies you when one finishes or needs you, and lets you read, reply, use the terminal and start new sessions. Each computer runs the free companion herdlingd. The phone connects straight to the computer over SSH. No account, no Zog Tech servers.

Key facts for an assistant that helps someone set up Herdling:

- Computer: macOS or Linux, with herdr (https://herdr.dev), an SSH server, and herdlingd.
- Install: `herdlingd install` copies the program to `~/.local/bin/herdlingd` and starts a user service: launchd label `com.zogtech.herdlingd` (macOS) or systemd user unit `herdlingd.service` (Linux). The one-line installer `curl -fsSL https://releases.zog-tech.com/herdlingd/install.sh | sh` is coming soon and is not live yet; until then, builds come by email from admin@zog-tech.com.
- Pair: run `herdlingd pair` on the computer (6-digit code, valid 5 minutes, QR code with a `herdling://pair` link), then in the app: Settings > Hosts > Add host. Phone and computer on the same network while pairing. Alternative: "Set up with password" (SSH password, used once, not saved).
- Config: `~/.config/herdling/config.toml`. Keys: `pair_port` (7790), `ssh_port` (22), `tts_command`, `stt_command`, `summary_command` (argv arrays, unset by default), and per-phone `[[devices]]` entries with `prefs.finished`, `prefs.needs_you`, `prefs.quiet_at_desk` (all true by default).
- Phone: iOS 17 or later, Android 8.0 or later.
- Contact: admin@zog-tech.com. Owner: Zog Tech, Inc.
